'''Saber Squadron''' was an elite [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] unit and one of the [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]] stationed aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].

==History==
During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Saber Squadron was assigned to defend the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], a task that they carried out admirably in spite of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] loss at that battle. The famous Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], perhaps second only to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], led the squadron personally.
